description: Machine-measured architecture/engineering capability scorecard: Know Your Soul vs codegraph vs graphify. Our side is proven by real pytest proofs executed by bench/scorecard/run.py; opponent sides are documented manual evidence (repo path + line) with status supported/partial/absent.

scoring.capability_pass_rule: A capability scores its full weight for our side iff ALL its proof_tests exit 0 under pytest (skipped counts as NOT passed).
scoring.percent_formula: percent(subject) = 100 * points(subject) / total_weight; points(ours) = sum(weight of passing capabilities); points(opponent) = sum(weight * status_points[status])

composite.formula: final_vs(opponent) = 0.6 * capability_relative_vs(opponent) + 0.4 * bench_relative_vs(opponent); composite = mean(final_vs(codegraph), final_vs(graphify))
composite.bench_absent_rule: If no competitive bench ledger is found, bench_weight renormalizes to 0 and final == capability component; the ledger records bench_component.status=absent (never silently assumed).
composite.bench_ledger_shapes: explicit relative-percent mapping, or summary.per_system with know_your_soul/codegraph/graphify OK/FAILED/NOT_SUPPORTED counts (rate = OK/total, relative = 100*ours/opponent)
